title: Retainage on Major Project and Strategic Program Milestone Invoices
content:
On Professional Services Projects of the Major Project and Strategic Program classes, part of each milestone invoice is withheld as retainage until acceptance, at a rate set by the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services relationship.

**Rule.** A Major Project or Strategic Program engagement whose client holds a ClearPath agreement in active status on the ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise tier has 5.0 percent of the milestone invoice withheld as retainage until acceptance, a Major Project or Strategic Program engagement whose client holds no such agreement has 2.5 percent withheld, and any other engagement none.

| Engagement class | Client's ClearPath agreement | Retainage withheld until acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| Major Project or Strategic Program | active, on ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise | 5.0 percent of the milestone invoice |
| Major Project or Strategic Program | none of that kind (no agreement, one not in active status, or one on ClearPath Monitor, Essentials or Standard) | 2.5 percent of the milestone invoice |
| Assessment Engagement, Quick Start Project, Standard Project or Advanced Project | any | none |

Hypothetical illustration: a Strategic Program engagement whose client's only ClearPath agreement is in suspended status has 2.5 percent withheld; an Advanced Project engagement of a ClearPath Enterprise client has none withheld under this rule.
